_comment: 🎚️ The transient state lane of `s.wfc.wfc2d`'s editor (✏️editor/🫧️transient): its mutation vocabulary `Wfc2dTransientMutation` over `Wfc2dTransient`, measured by the plugin bridge on the surface coordinate, claimed by `../../🧪️tests/🫧️mutate-wfc-wfc2d-1-any-editor-transient` and backed by one committed vector per declared outcome class.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: `Wfc2dTransientMutation` is the transient state lane of `s.wfc.wfc2d`'s ✏️editor/🫧️transient surface: it holds the last solve's slot assignments and whether it ended in a contradiction. This is this repository's own editor state record, not a published format, so no third party implements it. What is under test is that each kind (`set-solve`) changes exactly its own part of `Wfc2dTransient`, that a kind declaring `no-op` leaves a record that already holds its value untouched with a warned `mutation.no-op`, and that every kind's computed inverse, read off the pre-mutation record, restores it exactly. Confidence comes from one committed, handcrafted (before, mutation, after, diff, outcome) vector per kind and declared outcome class under `../🧫️fixtures/`, exercised end to end through the production dispatch bridge, and from the inverse law as a metamorphic property.

candidatesConsidered.reason: An in-memory state container with arbitrary setter functions; it has no typed transient record, no per-kind mutation vocabulary and no computed inverse.
Persistent immutable collections; they version values structurally but define no mutation kinds, no-op guards or inverses over this surface's record.

referenceSurvey.whyNoneQualifies: `Wfc2dTransient` is a state record defined by this repository with its own typed mutation vocabulary; generic state containers can hold its values but cannot adjudicate what each kind must change, when it is a no-op, or what its inverse is.

provenance.attribution: Handcrafted before/mutation/after vector authored against this state lane's own schema; the diff and diagnostics are the production dispatch's, reviewed against the after-snapshot.

fixtureManifests.notes: A finished solve replaces the empty assignment table with its two slot assignments.
